title: 周末的家庭日

explanations.1: 一 is a numeral indicating quantity.
explanations.2: 家 is a measure word for family units.
explanations.3: 里 is a directional noun meaning inside.
explanations.4: 从 is a preposition indicating starting point.
explanations.5: 了 is an aspect particle indicating completion.
explanations.6: 会 is a modal verb expressing ability.
explanations.7: 他 is a personal pronoun referring to the younger brother.
explanations.8: 很 is a degree adverb modifying the adjective.
explanations.9: 两 is a numeral meaning two.
explanations.10: 块 is a measure word for pieces (e.g., meat).
explanations.11: 一起 is an adverb of scope meaning together.
explanations.12: 先 is a time adverb indicating first.
explanations.13: 前 is a directional noun meaning front.
explanations.14: 后 is a directional noun meaning back.
explanations.15: 外 is a directional noun meaning outside.

translation: On the weekend, our family was at home. Mother was cooking in the kitchen, Father came back from the market. I helped wash vegetables. My younger brother can't cook, he was watching TV. Later, Mother called us to eat. We ate the meal, the dishes were very delicious. I ate a lot of vegetables, my younger brother ate two pieces of meat. In the afternoon, we cleaned the house together. Mother had me wipe the table, I used two cloths. Father first swept the front, then swept the back. My younger brother dumped the trash, he went outside. We were all very happy.
